failure.summary: A representative guide can preserve its own root and arc length while the same arc-position displacement field stretches another follower with a different rest tangent. Root attachment, finite values, bounded guide motion and a green representative solver therefore do not prove dense displayed-follower inextensibility.

distinctFrom: HAIR-GUIDE-ARC-LENGTH-INVARIANT-001 checks the solved guide centerline; this case checks the downstream transfer from one guide to heterogeneous displayed follower paths.
HAIR-SCALP root/coverage cases check root and carrier identity; this case preserves both roots while producing follower stretch.
HAIR-BUNDLE-FRAME-TWIST-CONTINUITY-001 checks section-frame angular continuity; this case checks displayed centerline length after displacement transfer.
gate: Preserve F13's valid static-path, native-root, finite-value, motion and bounded representative-guide evidence; this Candidate does not reopen those claims.
A representative guide arc-length pass cannot substitute for measurements on the displayed follower paths that receive its delta field.

For a claim covering all 114171 displayed strands, compute per-strand segment strain and total arc drift for the complete census, then bind the maximum and the corresponding hair/clump identity. Aggregate mean or 86 root-only GPU samples are insufficient.
Thresholds must be frozen before the run and justified for the exact Hair task; synthetic fixture values are not production thresholds.
Inject a rigid-rotation representative delta that preserves the representative arc but stretches an orthogonal follower, and prove the independent verifier rejects it.

A scoped pass proves only bounded centerline distortion under the tested motion frames. It does not prove independent per-strand physics, finite-width collision, self-contact, appearance quality or USER-ACCEPTED.
boundedHypothesis: If one representative displacement field is valid for all displayed followers in its clump, then a complete follower census must stay within pre-frozen segment/arc limits, and a rigid-guide/orthogonal-follower positive control must be rejected even though the guide root and arc length remain exact.
activationGate: Hair Mother implements the receipt on one immutable F13 descendant and an independent verifier runs the positive control plus complete follower census; coordinator review is required before activation.
rollback: Remove the Candidate receipt/check only; preserve F12/F13 geometry, motion, optics and existing evidence.
